integrity: Exact finite rank enumeration, independent modular Krylov cross-check, and analytic spectral reduction are provided. Priority is best-knowledge rather than externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the uniform-coherent-hopping, one-particle, 14-vertex Fano incidence network with strictly positive local loss rates; eventual capture only, not decay rates, disorder, repeated measurements, or interacting particles.
title: Exact minimum-absorber placement census on the Heawood quantum network
